WITH player_balls AS (
  SELECT 
    bb.striker as player_id,
    m.season_id,
    m.match_id,
    COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    AND m.season_id = 5
),
player_match_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    match_id,
    SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs,
    COUNT(*) as balls_faced
  FROM player_balls
  GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_season_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    pms.player_id,
    SUM(pms.match_runs) as total_runs,
    SUM(pms.balls_faced) as total_balls_faced,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pms.match_id) as matches_played,
    SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pms.match_id) as avg_runs_per_match,
    SUM(pms.match_runs) * 1.0 / SUM(pms.balls_faced) as batting_average
  FROM player_match_stats pms
  GROUP BY pms.player_id
)
SELECT 
  pss.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  pss.avg_runs_per_match,
  pss.batting_average,
  pss.total_runs,
  pss.batting_average as runs_per_ball
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN player p ON pss.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pss.avg_runs_per_match DESC
